stories.title: Where voters stand on state ballot measures, from abortion to LGBTQ rights to guns
stories.summary: Voters in dozens of states considered 146 statewide ballot measures this midterm cycle, on topics spanning LGBTQ rights, wealth taxes, abortion, redistricting, guns and more.

stories.title: Trump-backed redistricting sought a midterm edge for Republicans. It didn't work
stories.summary: Republicans lost most of the Democratic-held seats they had targeted to flip, lost others they had banked on retaining and got swept out of power by a Democratic surge fueled by voter dissatisfaction with Trump, the economy and the war…
